```{=html}
<div class="classifier-diagram" aria-label="Six-stage classification pipeline, an illustrative coded article, and three illustrative monthly distributions">
  <div class="classifier-stages">
    <div class="classifier-stage">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">1</span><h3>News corpus</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">Collect articles<br>Preprocess text<br>Retain source + date</div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-note">Domestic and international sources</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">2</span><h3>Translation</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">Title and body<br>English text<br>Check usable input</div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-note">Full supplied text</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage classifier-stage-focus">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">3</span><h3>Civic classifiers</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-encoder">Civic-event type</div>
      <div class="classifier-encoder">Civic relevance</div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-note">Two encoder models<br>Both filters required</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage classifier-stage-focus">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">4</span><h3>GenAI coding</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">One article / request<br>Action + entities<br>Labels + evidence</div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-note">Batch API, fixed prompt</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">5</span><h3>Checks</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">JSON + exact spans<br>Verified storage<br>Check codability</div>
    </div>
    <div class="classifier-stage">
      <div class="classifier-stage-heading"><span class="classifier-number">6</span><h3>Analytical views</h3></div>
      <div class="classifier-stage-copy">Government-month<br>Outlet, actor, action<br>Shares, net and P</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="classifier-detail-row">
    <div class="classifier-record">
      <div class="classifier-panel-heading">Inside one coded record <span>synthetic example</span></div>
      <div class="classifier-example">“Police dispersed peaceful anti-government demonstrators.”</div>
      <div class="classifier-record-columns">
        <div class="classifier-entities">
          <div class="classifier-detail-label">What the record identifies</div>
          <div class="classifier-entity-row"><strong>gov</strong><span>National incumbent at publication</span></div>
          <div class="classifier-entity-row"><strong>act</strong><span>“dispersed peaceful anti-government demonstrators”</span></div>
          <div class="classifier-entity-row"><strong>actor</strong><span>Police</span></div>
          <div class="classifier-entity-row"><strong>target</strong><span>Peaceful anti-government demonstrators</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="classifier-labels">
          <div class="classifier-detail-label">Three judgments about the incumbent</div>
          <div class="classifier-code-row"><strong>Alignment</strong><span class="classifier-code classifier-positive">+1</span><span class="classifier-code-copy"><span class="classifier-question">Action supports or opposes?</span><span>Restricts explicit opponents</span></span></div>
          <div class="classifier-code-row"><strong>Reputation</strong><span class="classifier-code classifier-negative">−1</span><span class="classifier-code-copy"><span class="classifier-question">Implication for government?</span><span>Negative legitimacy implication</span></span></div>
          <div class="classifier-code-row"><strong>Framing</strong><span class="classifier-code classifier-zero">0</span><span class="classifier-code-copy"><span class="classifier-question">Narrator approval or criticism?</span><span>No added evaluation</span></span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="classifier-record-note">Cabinet affiliation supplied. Adding “a necessary operation that restored order” changes framing to +1.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="classifier-months">
      <div class="classifier-panel-heading">Illustrative months</div>
      <div class="classifier-month-head"><span></span><span>Net N</span><span>P</span></div>
      <div class="classifier-month">
        <div class="classifier-month-name">All zero-coded</div>
        <div class="classifier-month-data"><div class="classifier-distribution" aria-label="100 percent zero"><span class="classifier-bar-zero" style="width:100%"></span></div><span>0</span><strong>0</strong></div>
      </div>
      <div class="classifier-month">
        <div class="classifier-month-name">One-sided</div>
        <div class="classifier-month-data"><div class="classifier-distribution" aria-label="40 percent zero and 60 percent positive"><span class="classifier-bar-zero" style="width:40%"></span><span class="classifier-bar-positive" style="width:60%"></span></div><span>.60</span><strong>0</strong></div>
      </div>
      <div class="classifier-month">
        <div class="classifier-month-name">Both directions</div>
        <div class="classifier-month-data"><div class="classifier-distribution" aria-label="45 percent negative, 10 percent zero and 45 percent positive"><span class="classifier-bar-negative" style="width:45%"></span><span class="classifier-bar-zero" style="width:10%"></span><span class="classifier-bar-positive" style="width:45%"></span></div><span>0</span><strong>.81</strong></div>
      </div>
      <div class="classifier-legend"><span><i class="classifier-bar-negative"></i>−</span><span><i class="classifier-bar-zero"></i>0</span><span><i class="classifier-bar-positive"></i>+</span></div>
      <div class="classifier-formula-row">N = p⁺ − p⁻<br>Proposed P = 4p⁺p⁻</div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="classifier-footnote">Zero: neutral, mixed or insufficient directional evidence. Null: not codable, kept separate. Synthetic months, not observed countries.</div>
</div>
```
